mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_resource_command(id, actor_user_id, request_id, request_hash, origin, canvas_id, agent_run_id, tool_call_id, request_json, create_time) VALUES (#{row.id}, #{row.actorUserId}, #{row.requestId}, #{row.requestHash}, #{row.origin}, #{row.canvasId}, #{row.agentRunId}, #{row.toolCallId}, #{row.requestJson}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE id = id
mapper.select: SELECT id, request_hash, result_json FROM afv_resource_command WHERE actor_user_id = #{userId} AND request_id = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_resource_command SET result_json = #{receipt}, undo_json = #{undo}, committed_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{id} AND result_json IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_resource_event(event_id, command_id, resource_type, resource_id, project_id, resource_version, deleted, changed_fields, create_time) VALUES (#{row.eventId}, #{row.commandId}, #{row.resourceType}, #{row.resourceId}, #{row.projectId}, #{row.resourceVersion}, #{row.deleted}, #{row.changedFields}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
mapper.select: SELECT last_sequence FROM afv_resource_feed_head WHERE id = 1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM afv_resource_event WHERE published = FALSE ORDER BY id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_resource_feed(sequence_no, event_id) SELECT #{sequence}, event_id FROM afv_resource_event WHERE id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE afv_resource_feed_head SET last_sequence = #{sequence} WHERE id = 1
UPDATE afv_resource_event SET published = TRUE, published_at = UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{eventId} AND published = FALSE
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT c.id FROM afv_canvas c LEFT JOIN afv_canvas_node n ON n.canvas_id = c.id AND n.deleted = FALSE WHERE c.project_id = #{projectId} OR (n.resource_type = #{type} AND n.resource_id = #{resourceId}) ORDER BY c.id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO afv_canvas_event(id, canvas_id, sequence_no, event_type, payload_json, create_time) VALUES (UUID(), #{canvasId}, #{sequence}, 'resource.changed', #{payload}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6))
INSERT INTO afv_resource_event_canvas(event_id, canvas_id, sequence_no) VALUES (#{eventId}, #{canvasId}, #{sequence})
mapper.select: SELECT f.sequence_no, e.* FROM afv_resource_feed f JOIN afv_resource_event e ON e.event_id = f.event_id WHERE f.sequence_no > #{after} AND f.sequence_no <= #{head} ORDER BY f.sequence_no LIMIT #{limit}
